remarks: Build something distinctly yours on an impressive 100 x 517 homesite on Casey Road in East Amherst with Brownstone Homes. The home shown offers approximately 4,044 square feet of finished living space, including approximately 2,944 square feet above grade and an additional 1,100 square feet in the finished lower level. Designed with 4 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and 2 half bathrooms, the layout is highlighted by a dramatic 2 story great room with a wall of windows and a spacious first floor primary suite. The kitchen is designed for both everyday living and entertaining with custom cabinetry, a large center island with breakfast bar seating, walk in pantry, beverage station, premium appliances, and an adjoining dining area. The 1st floor primary suite features a generous walk in closet and private bath with dual vanities, soaking tub, and separate shower. Upstairs are 3 additional bedrooms, walk in closets, and 2 full bathrooms. The finished lower level adds approximately 1,100 square feet of additional living space along with a half bathroom, offering room for a home theater, recreation area, gym, office, or whatever best fits your lifestyle. This design is only one of the possibilities for the property. Buyers may build this home as shown, personalize the floor plan and finishes, or work with Brownstone Homes to create an entirely different custom residence from the ground up. Pictures shown include renderings as well as previously completed Brownstone Homes residences and are intended to showcase the quality, design, finishes, and possibilities available when building with Brownstone Homes. Final plans, specifications, pricing, site work, finishes, and features will vary based on buyer selections and final design. Taxes to be determined by the town after completion.
